metadata.description: Second of the three Elf-fathers who awoke at Cuiviénen. His name is Quenya for 'Two, Second'. Together with his spouse Tatië, they were the second Elves to awaken. When walking with the other Fathers, Tata found and took the second group of 18 Elves. He also took the fourth group of 36 Elves because Imin refused, expecting an even greater group. Thus Tata gathered 54 companions total, becoming the Tatyar ('Seconds'). His followers became the ancestors of the Noldor and the Tatyarin Avari. His children included Maidros and Nurwe, ancestors of those who stayed behind.
